frozen_by: sst-kernel.mjs in this repository. A freeze, not a cross-implementation agreement — see vectors/README.md.
note: A gate nobody has watched refuse is a comment. Each file below is a frozen page with ONE edit, and each names the check that must catch it; `refuses` is the exact list `verify` reports, so a gate that stops refusing, starts refusing something else, or starts refusing two things at once moves these values. All but the last edit passed all six gates of the previous format version unchanged — that is why they exist. The last is the control: an edit the previous version already caught, which must still be caught in the same place. Nine of the ten edit page.html; sst-charter-field-flipped.html edits page-sst-charter-field.html, which serves the same terms in the second charter shape and must itself pass all nine.
